title: Zesty Light Norwegian Rice Flour Wrap
description: A briny and bouncy Norwegian dish featuring sweet rice flour chapssalgaru, confit tomato, and ayurvedic tamasic friendly ingredients, all wrapped in a ti leaf wrap.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sweet rice flour, salt, black pepper, and ayurvedic tamasic friendly spice blend.
Gradually add in the water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat and brush with olive oil.
Place a ti leaf on each circle of dough and top with confit tomato.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a wrap and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
